authority: ODA DWG specification v5.4.1 section 28 defines the pre-R2007 EED length and two-byte codepage field. The producer-generated controls below establish the observed value 45 and byte profile; this does not assign it to other revisions or fields.
checks: The generator independently walks the selected bounded dictionary frame, verifies CRC and APPID handle, and compares exact EED bytes in both revisions.
ODA reopens each DWG and exports the original non-ASCII dictionary and line EED values; ezdxf independently reads the reopened DXF.
The libdxfrw physical-source test checks decoded dictionary and line values and the source text observation; generated malformed UTF-8 and unknown-version controls retain the appropriate issue flags.
The focused EED and legacy transaction tests run under ASan; existing output qualification remains fail-closed.
limits: This is one producer/build and two legacy revisions, not a general header, XRECORD, other-version or native AutoCAD codepage mapping.
Correct text decoding alone does not qualify cloning/default semantics, graph closure, output or complete-file support.
The generated drawings are kept outside the repository.
